$comment: Changes reach main only through the dev → main release PR, merged with a merge commit after 'pr-check / Release PR' passed: dev's commits reach main unchanged, so dev catches up without a force-push. The Release workflow fails on a squash or rebase merge; this ruleset hides those buttons. DISABLED by default: the Release workflow pushes the `chore(release): X.Y.Z` commit to main with GITHUB_TOKEN, so the GitHub Actions app (Integration 15368) must be able to bypass it. Enable it per repo with .github/rulesets/require-release-pr.json containing {"enforcement": "active"}, run one release, and confirm it went through. Reference: docs/REPO_RULES.md.
name: ci: require release pull request
